# Arihant Anchal Jodhpur — Premium 2 BHK & 4 BHK Residential Flats

> Arihant Anchal is a JDA & RERA approved (RAJ/P/2017/322) gated residential township in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India. Developed by Arihant Superstructures Ltd. (est. 1994, Chairman: Mr. Ashok Chhajer). Offering 2 BHK (900 sq.ft from ₹41 Lakhs) and 4 BHK (1800 sq.ft from ₹82 Lakhs) premium flats. 500+ families already living. ISO certified, Vastu compliant.

## Key Project Facts
- Developer: Arihant Superstructures Ltd.
- Chairman: Mr. Ashok Chhajer (30+ years experience)
- Location: Near Dali Bai Circle, Jaisalmer Bypass Road, Jodhpur, Rajasthan 342014
- Coordinates: 26.2359°N, 73.0314°E
- Project Area: 18.5 acres
- Total Residential Units: 2324
- Structure: Stilt + 7 Floors
- Approvals: JDA approved, RERA: RAJ/P/2017/322, ISO certified
- Families Currently Living: 500+
- Google Rating: 4.2/5 (109 reviews)
- Website: https://www.arihantanchal.in

## Available Flat Types

### 2 BHK Executive Series
- Carpet Area: 900 sq.ft
- Price: Starting ₹41 Lakhs (approx ₹4,500/sq.ft)
- Features: 2 bedrooms, dual balconies, modular kitchen, vitrified flooring, Vastu compliant
- Home Loan: Available from SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis Bank

### 4 BHK Luxury Series
- Carpet Area: 1800 sq.ft
- Price: Starting ₹82 Lakhs (approx ₹4,555/sq.ft)
- Features: 4 bedrooms, grand living & dining hall, master suite with dressing room, private terrace, Vastu compliant
- Home Loan: Available from all major banks
